description: This file implements API routes for managing residents, including listing, exporting, importing via CSV, and CRUD operations. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic models to define endpoints with filtering, sorting, pagination, file upload, and CSV processing.

methods.name: Optional[str] _strip_or_none(val: Optional[str])
methods.description: Normalize incoming string values by trimming and converting blank strings to None.

methods.name: _apply_text_search(stmt, q: Optional[str])
methods.description: Add case-insensitive partial match filter for resident name.

methods.name: _apply_advanced_filters( stmt, *, name: Optional[str], building: Optional[str], unit: Optional[str], phone: Optional[str], email: Optional[str], updated_at_from: Optional[datetime], updated_at_to: Optional[datetime], )
methods.description: Apply optional filters for name, building, unit, phone, email, and updated_at range to SQL query.

methods.name: _apply_sort(stmt, *, sort_by: ResidentSortField, sort_dir: SortDirection)
methods.description: Apply server-side sorting based on a whitelist of sortable fields and direction.

methods.name: _build_filtered_stmt( *, q: Optional[str], name: Optional[str], building: Optional[str], unit: Optional[str], phone: Optional[str], email: Optional[str], updated_at_from: Optional[datetime], updated_at_to: Optional[datetime], sort_by: ResidentSortField, sort_dir: SortDirection, )
methods.description: Construct base SQLAlchemy select statement with filters and sorting applied.

methods.name: int _count_total(db: Session, filtered_stmt)
methods.description: Count total number of rows matching filtered SQL query.

methods.name: Iterable[Tuple[int,Dict[str,str]]] _iter_csv_rows(file_obj: io.TextIOBase)
methods.description: Generator yielding row number and row data from a CSV file.

methods.name: List[str] _validate_import_headers(fieldnames: Optional[Sequence[str]])
methods.description: Check for missing required CSV headers.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[str]] _normalize_row(row: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Trim and normalize CSV row values to known headers.

methods.name: Optional[Resident] _find_existing_for_upsert( db: Session, *, name: Optional[str], unit: Optional[str], email: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Find existing resident for upsert based on email (case-insensitive) or name+unit.
